mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_item ( batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at ) SELECT #{batchId}, ke.exchange_id, NULL, NULL FROM krw_exchange ke INNER JOIN sell_order so ON so.order_id = ke.order_id WHERE ke.settlement_status = 'PROVISIONAL' AND ke.provisional_at < CAST(#{executedAt} AS DATE) AND so.status = 'EXECUTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item existing_item WHERE existing_item.batch_id = #{batchId} AND existing_item.exchange_id = ke.exchange_id ) ORDER BY ke.exchange_id
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, batch_id, exchange_id, result, processed_at FROM settlement_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND result IS NULL AND item_id > #{itemId} ORDER BY item_id LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND result IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND result = 'FAILED'
